comment_regular: Verified: Inserts a search-node index into the single AStarWorldNodeList. Reads that index's fitness from the 0x10-byte transient state table and keeps the list in ascending fitness order (before first >=, otherwise tail). This differs from Fallout's TeleportDoorSearch AStarQueue: Fallout AddNode selects one of 20 buckets from normalized fitness, then sorts within that bucket.
